parameters.name: PageNumber
parameters.description:
The number of the page to return.

Pages start from page 1.

Default value: 1

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description:
The number of entries to return on each page.

Maximum value: 50.

Default value: 10.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description:
The region ID of the scenario.

You can call the [DescribeRegions](~~131035~~) operation to query the most recent region list.

parameters.name: ResourceGroupId
parameters.description: The ID of the resource group.

parameters.name: Status
parameters.description:
The status of the scenario. Valid values:

*   GENERATE_IN_PROGRESS: The scenario is being created.
*   GENERATE_COMPLETE: The scenario is created.
*   GENERATE_FAILED: The scenario fails to be created.

parameters.name: TemplateScratchType
parameters.description:
The type of the resource scenario. Valid values:

*   ArchitectureReplication: resource replication
*   ArchitectureDetection: resource detection
*   ResourceImport: resource management
*   ResourceMigration: resource migration

example.unifiedCli: aliyun ros list-template-scratches --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --template-scratch-id ts-7f7a704cf71c49a60000 --template-scratch-type ArchitectureReplication --status GENERATE_COMPLETE --tags Value=test Key=usage --page-size 10 --page-number 1 --resource-group-id rg-acfmxazb4ph6aiy0000 --region cn-hangzhou
